title: Waylan NDE 737
content:
My experience was in 1987 after my first open heart surgery which had been lengthy. It was after recovery and now I'm back in a room and I'm dying. I'm aware those caring for me know I'm dying and they cannot understand why. I was doing some serious praying because of this. I was not aware of any movement, such as going through a tunnel. Instantly, I was in the presence of God and I was hearing that I was not to fear as I was all right, instantly all fear was gone and I knew that I was all right. I do remember many other people being there, some I recognized and some not although I was aware that I knew them all. It is impossible to explain the love God has for us. No one would ever voluntarily leave God. I ache to return. Then a female preacher, whom I had met once about a year before, stepped forward and our task was to pray with and for specific people in different areas of Baylor Hospital in Dallas where I was located. We went to these people through space, walls and closed doors. I could not tell that I was out of my body. Everything looked and felt normal. I remember thinking that this must be the same kind of body that Jesus was in after coming out of the tomb. He went through walls, yet ate and drank, was seen and was felt by his companions. I do not know how much time was involved. When I returned to my bed, they were giving me blood and I was told that the machine processing it during surgery had damaged my blood. I intended to check to see if the female preacher had died, but I never did. Maybe she could have been there and been alive. For years after this experience, I could not tell this story without crying like a baby because I would remember the feeling of God's love.

arrival.other_being_detail: Many other people were present; some recognized and some not, but the experiencer felt they knew them all.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: A female preacher stepped forward and their task was to pray with and for specific people in different areas of Baylor Hospital in Dallas; they went to them through space, walls, and closed doors.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: After a lengthy first open heart surgery; after recovery back in a room and 'I'm dying'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Instant presence of God; many other people present; accompanied by a female preacher to pray for people throughout the hospital by moving through walls/doors; return to bed while being given blood.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or clear OBE separation described; the experience began instantly in the presence of God and then shifted to moving around the hospital with a female preacher before returning to the bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Mission-like activity during the experience: traveling through the hospital (through space, walls, and closed doors) with a female preacher to pray with/for specific patients; the experiencer reported they 'could not tell that I was out of my body' and that everything looked and felt normal.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Instantly, I was in the presence of God and I was hearing that I was not to fear as I was all right, instantly all fear was gone and I knew that I was all right.” / “It is impossible to explain the love God has for us. No one would ever voluntarily leave God. I ache to return.” / “We went to these people through space, walls and closed doors. I could not tell that I was out of my body. Everything looked and felt normal.”
